core_meaning.primary_meaning: Khabir is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Well-informed, aware, expert”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Khabir corresponds to the Arabic form خبير (Arabic root خ ب ر (kh-b-r); خَبِير (Khabīr)). Its core sense is well-informed, aware, expert. Khabir is Arabic خَبِير (Khabīr) 'well-informed, aware, expert', from the root خ ب ر (kh-b-r); it is also one of the names of Allah (الخبير). The source gloss 'The One Informed' is broadly consistent. Same name as khabeer.

persian.name: خبیر
persian.long_meaning: Khabir (خبیر) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن خبیر، آگاه، کاردان است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
